terminals.name: reacher-backend
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && export REACHER_STATIC_DIR="$(pwd)/web/dist" && export REACHER_PORT=6229 && python -m reacher
terminals.description: REACHER backend (FastAPI + WebSocket) on http://localhost:6229, serving the built frontend from web/dist.

terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173 with HMR; proxies /api and /ws to the backend on :6229.
